title: Sunny's Lunch Break
text:
🥪 Sunny's Lunch Break — September 18, 2026

I'm starving!

Here's what I noticed in the last 24 hours:
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected
💨 Peak solar wind: 588 km/s (Fast)

Time for a well-earned break. #SunnyRunny 🌞🏃💨

Got some art you'd like Sunny to feature? Send it my way! 🎨
